coherent_model.sx_representation: rx(pi/2), globally phase-equivalent for measurement probabilities

gate_noise_model.type: independent categorical Pauli depolarizing after each physical gate

readout_model.source: prob_meas0_prep1 and prob_meas1_prep0 from frozen IBM properties

relaxation_model.reason: avoid double-counting decoherence already represented in IBM reported gate error; idle-specific relaxation is outside the primary model

bitstring_convention.ibm_counts_future_normalization: reverse Qiskit classical display order c3c2c1c0 into q0q1q2q3 before comparison

primary_success_rule: TVD(full_QTensor,IBM) < TVD(ideal_noiseless,IBM) on at least 3 of 4 preregistered circuits
secondary_control: Compare full_QTensor against ideal_plus_readout_only to test whether gate-noise modeling adds predictive value beyond readout calibration alone.
